source: Retrospective analysis of the unchanged 2026-10-16 live-agent run.

timingSemantics.wallPartition: Exclusive monotonic clock intervals, sum equals original endpoint. Successful reads use the union across all actors, never summed overlapping durations.
timingSemantics.cliServiceSum: Client-observed subprocess latency including CLI/IPC/native/network/keyring/OS work. Sums are workload costs, not a wall-clock partition; subprocess calls can overlap.
timingSemantics.otherResearchWindow: Everything between first successful read and last save outside successful read envelopes: reasoning/provider/tool dispatch, formatting/file writes, save calls, failed reads and waits. These cannot be separated retrospectively.
timingSemantics.outsideTimedCliLowerBound: Elapsed actor window minus every timed CLI call duration; conservative with overlap. This is NOT a model inference duration.
timingSemantics.failedReadVisibility: Original events.jsonl logs successful reads only. Failed reads recovered from commands.jsonl have precise latency but no absolute start timestamp.
timingSemantics.cpuWindow: Native worker CPU accumulated from observer start until merge completion; not pure research CPU or native elapsed time.
